description: Referee-guarantees docs page promises that `rcf build finalise` is the only path that writes verified, that a chain that says verified traces to an actual post-merge runtime check, and that the finalise gate refuses on the three per-AC verdicts the aggregator already emits: UI-BASELINE-UNMET (docs claim C-28; also covers a block-severity probe-pack failure, C-36), BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING (C-29) and SCOPE-MISMATCH (C-30). The 0.27.0 finalise CLI only branched on MOCK-ONLY-DECLARED / BLOCKED-BY-DECLARATION and EVAL-MISSING / EVAL-BELOW-THRESHOLD; the three new verdicts were derived on the report but did not gate finalise. The manual override path (`rcf define update FBS.executionStatus=verified`) was accepted by the writer, defeating the C-22 promise. This train wires the three per-AC refusals in finalise (no ack path: the refusals are honest; fix the AC or its scope), gates the manual override behind `--acknowledge-verified-override` on `rcf define update` (per the escalation clause: existing WSD projects may still need the escape valve; the writer's default is now the documented behaviour), and adds a git default-branch precondition to finalise with `--allow-pre-merge` as the deliberate pre-merge dry-run opt-out. Closes referee-guarantees docs claims C-22 / C-26 / C-28 / C-29 / C-30 / C-36 (audit at reviews/2026-09-15-docs-claims-audit/how-it-works__what-the-referee-guarantees.json). C-33 (shipWithoutEval manifest field) remains open: the write path already exists (skips schema validation), but the rcf-schemas 0.6.2 manifest schema does not yet declare the field; the exact delta needed lands in the ship-without-eval.js comment and in the report for this dispatch. C-38 (per-check applicable:false in browserVerificationProbePackCheck) is also blocked on the rcf-schemas bump; source comments already flag it.
title: Referee guarantee: `rcf build finalise` refuses UI-BASELINE-UNMET / BROWSER-VERIFICATION-MISSING / SCOPE-MISMATCH; verified traces to a post-merge run; manual override is gated
